# About Hana

Hana Idris is a fictional person invented for this demo. She works as a ceramics teacher in a small studio.

## Work

Hana teaches wheel throwing three evenings a week. Her classes hold eight students each. She has taught for six years and keeps a waiting list of twenty names.

## Home

She lives in a rented flat with a balcony full of herbs. Her cat, Biscuit, sleeps on the kiln shelf.
